description: This file implements a shell script for configuring IPv6-in-IPv4 (6to4) tunneling in a network setup, particularly for OpenWrt. It includes functions for prefix calculation, address validation, setup, teardown, and initial configuration of the 6to4 protocol.

methods.name: find_6to4_prefix
methods.description: Calculates the 6to4 IPv6 prefix based on a provided IPv4 address.

methods.name: test_6to4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address belongs to private or special ranges according to RFC 1918 and RFC 6598.

methods.name: proto_6to4_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 6to4 tunnel by configuring IPv6 addresses, routes, and tunnel parameters.

methods.name: proto_6to4_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for tearing down the 6to4 configuration (currently empty).

methods.name: proto_6to4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the 6to4 protocol.
